column1: # Shared tumour antigens worth checking in a melanoma patient, as a
# second channel alongside the patient's own mutations. One row per gene:
# "class" groups the rows in the report; it carries no scoring. These are
# genes, not epitopes: whether a given patient can present anything from
# one depends on their alleles, which is why a peptide set for pVACbind
# (--taa_peptides) is the other half of this channel.
# Replace this file with your own via --taa_panel. Lines starting with #
# Cancer-testis antigens: silent in adult tissue outside testis, which is
# immune-privileged, so expression in the tumour makes a clean target.
